mkp-diagrams:network@1.name: network
mkp-diagrams:network@1.about: A graph laid out by forces: edges act as springs and nodes repel, so clusters show; replay the layout settling.

inputs.name: nodes
inputs.about: each node's id and what it shows

inputs.name: edges
inputs.about: pairs of node ids, with an optional label

inputs.name: seed
inputs.about: change it for a different starting layout

values.name: good

value.expr: filter(edges, e => indexof(ids, e.from) >= 0 and indexof(ids, e.to) >= 0 and e.from != e.to)

comment: edges between two known, different nodes, as index pairs

value.expr: map(range(0, n - 1), i => map(filter(good, e => e.from == ids[i] or e.to == ids[i]), e => if(e.from == ids[i], indexof(ids, e.to), indexof(ids, e.from))))

values.name: start

value.expr: map(range(0, n - 1), i => (cos(2 pi i/n) + 0.2 rand(seed, i), sin(2 pi i/n) + 0.2 rand(seed, i + 1000)))

comment: start on a circle with a little jitter, then 120 steps, each allowed to move a little less

value.expr: scan({p: start, t: 0.4}, 120, s => {p: relax(s.p, adj, k, s.t), t: 0.97 s.t})

label.expr: "a network of " + n + " nodes and " + len(good) + " edges"

mermaid.expr:
"flowchart LR
" + join(map(nodes, n => "  " + n.id + "["" + n.label + ""]"), "
") + "
" + join(map(good, e => "  " + e.from + if(directed, " -->", " ---") + if(e.label != "", "|" + e.label + "|", "") + " " + e.to), "
")

core:canvas@1.about: A 2D coordinate space with layers drawn in the order written.

inputs.name: aspect
inputs.about: width over height; 0 means from the ranges

inputs.name: view

mkp-diagrams:relax#0.name: relax
mkp-diagrams:relax#0.src: map(range(0, len(ps) - 1), i => ps[i] + cap(push(ps, i, k) - pull(ps, adj[i], i, k) - ps[i] * 0.05, temp))

mkp-diagrams:push#0.name: push
mkp-diagrams:push#0.src: fold(range(0, len(ps) - 1), (0, 0), (acc, j) => if(j == i, acc, acc + (ps[i] - ps[j]) * (k^2 / max(dist(ps[i], ps[j])^2, 0.0001))))

mkp-diagrams:pull#0.name: pull
mkp-diagrams:pull#0.src: fold(nb, (0, 0), (acc, j) => acc + (ps[i] - ps[j]) * (dist(ps[i], ps[j]) / k))

mkp-diagrams:fit#0.name: fit
mkp-diagrams:fit#0.src: map(ps, p => (if(max(map(ps, q => q.x)) > min(map(ps, q => q.x)), -w + 2 w (p.x - min(map(ps, q => q.x)))/(max(map(ps, q => q.x)) - min(map(ps, q => q.x))), 0), if(max(map(ps, q => q.y)) > min(map(ps, q => q.y)), -h + 2 h (p.y - min(map(ps, q => q.y)))/(max(map(ps, q => q.y)) - min(map(ps, q => q.y))), 0)))
